entities.summary: Travis Scott is a Canadian former professional ice hockey goaltender who played in one National Hockey League (NHL) game with the Los Angeles Kings during the 2000–01 season. He played most of his first nine professional seasons, from 1996 to 2005, in the American Hockey League (AHL) and East Coast Hockey League (ECHL). He spent the last six seasons of his career, 2005 to 2011, in Europe, playing in the Russian Superleague, the German Deutsche Eishockey Liga, the Austrian Hockey League, and the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL).
